rows.text: How enjoyable was the training protocol that you were assigned to?
How easy was it to adhere to your training protocol?
How manageable was the workload of your training sessions?
How effective was your training protocol in covering your training needs?
How likely are you to use the same or a similar training protocol in the future?
How much did the training protocol impact current or past injuries?
How effective was the training protocol on optimising performance for competition day?
How much did exogenous factors (stress, lack of sleep) affect your performance on competition day?
How effective was the coach’s involvement in improving performance during the training sessions?
How accurately did you follow the protocol’s guidelines (eg: RPE or load/reps assigned)?
How helpful was the RPE familiarisation period? (the weeks prior to the study)
How confident were you at utilising the RPE scale during training sessions?

limitations: Weekly ranges must not be expanded into invented daily prescriptions.
Week 10 MAX deadlift frequency conflicts between narrative and Table 2.
MAX participant 4 total change has conflicting signs in results prose and Table 5.
PER participant 1 post total precision differs from sum of component lifts.
Individual outcomes are not personal growth forecasts.
